name: Bartolo Posandi (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-01: Intro to the Year of Battle's Spark: Enough is Enough

items.name: Longsword
items.description: Longswords, also known as arming swords, can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 feet in length.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Half Plate] armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

defensiveAbilities.name: Retributive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy damages Bartolo's ally, and both are within 15 feet of him

Effect Bartolo protects his ally and strikes his foe The ally gains resistance 5 to all damage against the triggering damage If the foe is within reach, Bartolo makes a melee Strike against it

Effect: Champion's Resistance

defensiveAbilities.name: Shield Block (See Living Shield)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster has its shield raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The monster snaps its shield into place to deflect a blow. The shield prevents the monster from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. The monster and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.

offensiveAbilities.name: Living Shield
offensiveAbilities.description: Bartolo grapples a creature and uses it as a shield, gaining +2 to his AC and the Shield Block reaction while the target is grappled. Use the creature's level plus item bonus to AC (if any) as its Hardness.
